notes: Closing the app during the placement test no longer strands you on lesson 1: the test is offered again next time, because it now counts as done when a placement is actually saved rather than when the test opens. The explanation is its own screen with a Start button instead of a paragraph sitting on top of question one, and it no longer promises a retake that does not exist. Eight Portuguese questions now say what they are asking, and one Croatian question stopped printing its own answer in the hint.
